📖 How to use

  4. Read the result and the full conversion table for all seven units.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which weight units are supported?

Milligrams, grams, kilograms, ounces, pounds, stones and metric tonnes.

Is a tonne the same as a US ton?

No. This tool uses the metric tonne (1,000 kg). A US short ton is 907.185 kg — close, but not the same.

How accurate is the pounds conversion?

It uses the international avoirdupois definition: 1 pound = 453.59237 grams exactly.
